collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager notices a line of small bird tracks crossing the wet sand.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) notices a line of small bird tracks crossing the wet sand. (name1) follows them until they end where the bird took flight.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) notices a line of small bird tracks crossing the wet sand. (name1) tries to walk exactly in them and nearly falls over.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) notices a line of small bird tracks crossing the wet sand. The tracks circle around and around, as if the bird was dancing.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) notices a line of small bird tracks crossing the wet sand. A child asks whose tracks they are, and (name1) does not know but guesses happily.
